body:
Founder ask: 'make it work for Friends and Duels' (WOTAN/friends.html), the direct follow-up to SECTION 543's store.html SSO cutover. Investigated and found a real architecture gap: DEADWEIGHT friends/duels endpoints require a game-scoped player token (player_id/game/permissions claims from game_online.go's playerToken), but the generic SSO JWT (player_email_auth.go's shape) has none of those claims and fails draftPlayerClaims outright -- even though both token shapes ultimately authenticate the exact same underlying players row. Added POST /api/v1/games/{game}/sso-exchange: takes an already-valid generic SSO token as proof of identity, and if a real players row exists for that identity scoped to this game, mints a real playerToken for it. No new player is ever created -- an unlinked identity gets a real 404, not a silent registration. TestSSOExchange_GenericSSOTokenBecomesAUsableGamePlayerToken proves the full real round trip end to end (guest-register -> guest-upgrade -> generic SSO login -> exchange -> the exchanged token actually authenticates against the real friendsList endpoint), plus a negative-case test. go build/vet/test ./... all clean. IDUNA 50655f5, rebuilt to ~/.local/bin/iduna -- iduna.service restart needed to carry this live.

⚓ ☃
title: New sso-exchange endpoint bridges generic IDUNA SSO into game-scoped player tokens (WOTAN Friends & Duels)
